find_rows.description: Find the rows of a Coda table whose column holds exactly the value you give, such as every task whose Status is Done.
find_rows.display_str_template: Find rows in table '{1}' where {2} is '{3}'.
find_rows.name: find_rows

parameters.description: The ID of the Coda doc. Use the List docs action to find it.
parameters.name: doc_id

parameters.description: The ID of the table. Use the List tables in a doc action to find it.
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.description: The name of the column to look in, as it appears in the table, such as Status.
parameters.name: column

parameters.description: The value the column must hold, exactly, such as Done. Capital letters count.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: Optional. The most rows to return, up to 500. Defaults to 100.
parameters.name: limit

index.description: The row's position in the table
